zh.privacy_intro: 我的個人空間（下稱「本網站」）尊重你的私隱。本頁同時說明本網站如何處理瀏覽本網站時所產生的資料，以及在你主動向本網站提供個人資料時適用的安排。本網站以《個人資料（私隱）條例》（香港法例第486章）為主要參考。
zh.privacy_collection_body: 當你瀏覽本網站時，伺服器會自動接收及處理部分技術及使用資料，包括你到訪的路徑、到訪時間、由 Cloudflare 提供的國家／地區代碼、瀏覽器在每個分頁首次到訪時所傳送的來源網址（「document.referrer」；本網站只會保留其中的來源主機名稱，並排除本網站自己的網域），以及用於區分瀏覽器的訪客雜湊。就訪客統計而言，本網站不會把原始 IP 地址寫入 D1 資料庫：IP 地址會先與本網站專用的 salt 組合並以 SHA-256 雜湊，之後才用於統計及防止重複寫入；本網站不儲存你的 User-Agent 字串或完整來源網址。你毋須主動提供上述技術資料；如你透過電郵或其他方式主動聯絡本網站，是否提供個人資料一般屬自願，但沒有提供所需資料可能令本網站無法回覆你的查詢。
zh.privacy_purpose_body: 本網站使用上述資料的目的包括：提供、維持及保障網站服務；製作及分析網站瀏覽量與訪客統計（趨勢及熱門項目只涵蓋最近 30 日，首頁總瀏覽量及不重複訪客數字涵蓋最近 180 日）；了解網站的使用情況；診斷及處理技術問題；以及防止濫用、惡意請求、過量請求及其他影響網站正常運作的行為。本網站不會為跨網站追蹤、個人化廣告或向第三者出售個人資料而收集上述資料。
zh.privacy_thirdparty_title: 第三者服務及外部資源
zh.privacy_thirdparty_body: 本網站使用 Cloudflare Workers、Cloudflare D1、Cloudflare R2 及 Cloudflare Turnstile 等 Cloudflare 服務。首頁的 Discord 活動面板使用 Lanyard：你的瀏覽器會直接連接 wss://api.lanyard.rest，本網站伺服器亦會向 api.lanyard.rest 查詢。頁面會從 Discord 圖片 CDN、Spotify 圖片 CDN（用於 Discord 活動中的音樂封面）及 Steam 圖片 CDN 載入頭像與遊戲圖片；本網站伺服器亦會向 Steam Web API 及 Steam Store API 查詢公開的遊戲資料（例如遊戲名稱及封面）。頁尾包含 Ko-fi 及 Liberapay 的連結與圖片。當你瀏覽載有上述資源的頁面或使用相關功能時，你的瀏覽器可能直接與該等第三者建立連線，你的 IP 地址及瀏覽器傳送的技術資料會按該等第三者的服務設定及私隱政策處理。Turnstile 只在需要時載入，並會向 challenges.cloudflare.com 發出請求。本網站不加入第三方廣告、跨網站追蹤像素或社交媒體外掛；就直接向本網站提供的個人資料而言，本網站不會把資料轉移或披露予與所述目的無關的第三者。
zh.privacy_local_body: 本網站使用 localStorage 保存網站設定：語言（bm-lang）、主題（theme）及背景影片開關（bm-bg-video）。這些設定只儲存在你的瀏覽器，不會傳送給本網站伺服器。訪客統計使用由本網站伺服器發出的第一方 Cookie「__Host-bm-visit」（HttpOnly、Secure、SameSite=Lax，有效期約 30 日）：用途是辨識再次到訪的瀏覽器，並在已持有有效 Cookie 時免除 Turnstile 檢查。該 Cookie 並非登入憑證，亦不作跨網站追蹤，而且不會抑制訪客統計的寫入——每次到訪仍會嘗試記錄為一次瀏覽（同一訪客雜湊、同一路徑在 30 秒內的重複請求只計一次）。刪除或拒絕此 Cookie 後，你下次到訪可能被視為新訪客，並可能被要求完成一次 Turnstile 人機驗證；訪客統計仍會正常運作。若本網站未設定 TURNSTILE_SECRET，就不會載入 Turnstile，也不會顯示驗證畫面。第三者資源可能按其本身的服務設定使用 Cookies 或類似技術。
zh.privacy_retention_body: 訪客統計資料（包括到訪路徑、加鹽 SHA-256 訪客雜湊、國家／地區代碼、來源主機名稱及時間）保存於 Cloudflare D1。用於趨勢、熱門頁面、國家及來源的彙總只查詢最近 30 日；首頁總瀏覽量及不重複訪客數字則涵蓋最近 180 日。超過 180 日的訪客紀錄會在成功寫入統計後以機會式方式刪除：大約 1% 的寫入、每個 Worker isolate 每個 UTC 日最多一次，而且不會在讀取（GET）時執行；網站沒有設定定時清理排程。Cloudflare Workers 的日誌及追蹤資料則按相關 Cloudflare 服務及帳戶設定保存。本網站持有的其他個人資料只會在達致收集目的所需的期間內保存，並會定期檢視是否仍有保存的實際需要。
zh.privacy_security_body: 本網站採用 HTTPS 及合理可行的技術及管理措施，以保障其所持有的資料免受未獲授權或意外的查閱、處理、刪除、喪失或使用。基於互聯網及電子儲存的性質，本網站不能保證資料傳送或儲存絕對安全。

en.privacy_intro: My Personal Space (the “Website”) respects your privacy. This page explains how the Website handles information arising from browsing the Website and the arrangements that apply when you voluntarily provide personal data. It is prepared with reference to the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486) of Hong Kong.
en.privacy_collection_body: When you browse the Website, the server automatically receives and processes some technical and usage information, including the path you visited, the time of the visit, the country/region code supplied by Cloudflare, the referring URL that the browser sends on the first visit of each tab (document.referrer — the Website keeps only the referring hostname and excludes the Website's own domains), and a visitor hash used to tell browsers apart. For visitor statistics, the raw IP address is not written to the D1 database: it is first combined with a site-specific salt and processed with SHA-256, and only that hash is used for statistics and duplicate-write prevention. The Website does not store your User-Agent string or the full referring URL. You are not required to provide the technical data above directly. If you voluntarily contact the Website by email or another means, providing personal data is generally voluntary, but failing to provide information reasonably needed to answer your enquiry may prevent the Website from responding.
en.privacy_purpose_body: The Website uses the information for purposes including providing, maintaining and securing the Website; producing and analysing page-view and visitor statistics (trends and top items cover the last 30 days; the homepage total-views and unique-visitor figures cover the last 180 days); understanding website usage; diagnosing and resolving technical problems; and preventing abuse, malicious requests, excessive requests and other conduct that may affect normal operation. The Website does not collect the above data for cross-site tracking, personalised advertising or the sale of personal data to third parties.
en.privacy_thirdparty_body: The Website uses Cloudflare services including Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1, Cloudflare R2 and Cloudflare Turnstile. The homepage Discord activity panel uses Lanyard: your browser connects directly to wss://api.lanyard.rest and the Website server also queries api.lanyard.rest. Pages load avatars and game artwork from the Discord image CDN, the Spotify image CDN (for music artwork shown in a Discord activity) and the Steam image CDN; the Website server also queries the Steam Web API and the Steam Store API for public game data such as names and cover images. The footer contains links to and images from Ko-fi and Liberapay. When you visit a page containing those resources or use related features, your browser may connect directly to those third parties, and your IP address and the technical information your browser sends are handled under those third parties’ service settings and privacy policies. Turnstile is loaded only when needed and makes requests to challenges.cloudflare.com. The Website does not include third-party advertising, cross-site tracking pixels or social-media widgets; for personal data provided directly to the Website, the Website will not transfer or disclose it to third parties unrelated to the stated purposes.
en.privacy_local_body: The Website uses localStorage to store site settings: language (bm-lang), theme (theme) and background-video preference (bm-bg-video). These settings stay in your browser and are not sent to the Website server. Visitor statistics use a first-party Cookie issued by the Website server, __Host-bm-visit (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, about 30 days): it identifies a returning browser and, when a valid Cookie is present, avoids a Turnstile check. It is not a login credential and is not used for cross-site tracking; it does not suppress visitor-statistics writes — each visit still attempts a view record (a repeated request for the same path from the same visitor hash within 30 seconds counts once). After you delete or refuse this Cookie, your next visit may be treated as a new visitor and you may be asked to complete one Turnstile human-verification check; visitor statistics still work normally. If Turnstile is not configured on the Website (TURNSTILE_SECRET), Turnstile is not loaded and no verification is shown. Third-party resources may use Cookies or similar technologies under their own settings.
en.privacy_retention_body: Visitor-statistics data (visit path, salted SHA-256 visitor hash, country/region code, referring hostname and time) is stored in Cloudflare D1. Aggregations for trends, top pages, countries and referrers query the last 30 days only; the homepage total-views and unique-visitor figures cover the last 180 days. Visitor rows older than 180 days are deleted opportunistically after a successful statistics write: about 1% of writes, at most once per Worker isolate per UTC day, and never on a read (GET); no scheduled cleanup job is configured. Cloudflare Workers logs and traces are retained according to the relevant Cloudflare service and account settings. Any other personal data held by the Website is kept only for as long as necessary for the purposes of collection, with periodic review of whether a practical need remains.
en.privacy_security_body: The Website uses HTTPS and reasonable practicable technical and administrative measures to protect information in its possession against unauthorised or accidental access, processing, erasure, loss or use.
